recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, three-color portrait illustration featuring a man with glasses, rendered in loose black ink outlines and flat, textured color fields of green and yellow against a vibrant magenta background, framed by a rounded-corner border and a jagged geometric side-strip.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant magenta background contrasting with olive green and mustard yellow skin tones
Loose, expressive black contour lines defining the facial features and glasses
Geometric, saw-tooth pattern on the left vertical margin providing rhythmic contrast
Rounded-corner inner frame containing the portrait and typography
coreInvariants: Limited color palette of magenta, green, yellow, and black
Hand-drawn, sketchy quality to the central portrait lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait positioned slightly left of center, filling the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick-rimmed glasses and the high-contrast white typography on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the high-contrast white text, moves left to the eyes of the portrait, then follows the jagged border on the far left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid magenta fields provide breathing room around the head and behind the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Olive Green (shadows and mid-tones of the face)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with low value contrast between the magenta and green, relying on black lines for definition.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses ultra-bold, tightly tracked geometric capitals
Secondary text uses a thin, lowercase humanist sans with rounded terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is integrated closely between words in the secondary line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast: Ultra-bold geometric caps paired with ultra-light lowercase humanist.
graphicDevices: Vertical saw-tooth/zigzag border on the left
Small rectangular logo-box in bottom-left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, heavy uppercase display style
Provides the necessary humanist lowercase contrast for the secondary line

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a screen-printed style portrait of a man with glasses using loose black ink lines. Fill the face with flat, slightly textured patches of olive green and mustard yellow. Set this against a solid magenta background. Add a white rounded-corner border around the composition and a black vertical strip on the left containing a green zigzag pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white text on the right side. The top line should be ultra-bold geometric sans-serif capitals, right-aligned. The second line should be thin, lowercase humanist sans-serif, also right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait rendered in a loose, hand-drawn ink style?
Are the colors limited to magenta, green, yellow, and black?
Is the text right-aligned and high-contrast white?
Does the left border feature a sharp zigzag pattern?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the inner frame
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no photographic elements are present
Verify the rounded border does not clip the text
Check that the green and magenta do not vibrate excessively at the edges
Confirm the typography is perfectly right-aligned
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait in [Color A] and [Color B] ink lines + [Color C] background + Rounded Frame + Right-aligned [Bold/Thin] Type Pairing
